Set up the MMLV RT rxns with random primers using ~833ng DNAsed RNA (prepared yesterday) according to the Promega MMLV Product Insert. This procedure is slightly different than what is in our lab protocol for RT rxns. [Here is the workup for the rxns](./20090224-1.jpg). cDNA was stored @ -20C in the "Vibrio" box.
